senses.gloss:
ख 1. ख, the second consonant of the
alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding conso-
nant, and having the sound of kh in inkhorn.
—ख-
कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ख.
ख 2. ख, अस्, m. the sun.

ख 3. ख, अम्, n. (fr. rt. खन्), a cavity,
hollow, cave, cavern, aperture; an aperture of the
human body (of which there are nine, as the mouth,
the two ears, the two eyes, the two nostrils, and the
organs of excretion and generation); the glottis (in
anatomy); an organ of sense; the hole made by
an arrow, a wound; the hole in the nave of a
wheel through which the axis runs; vacuity, empty
space, air, ether, sky, heaven; the character in arith-
metic which expresses nothing, a cypher; a dot,
Anusvāra, represented by a circle (विन्दु); a city, a
field; happiness, pleasure, auspiciousness [cf. सुख
and दुःख]; understanding, knowledge; action;
the tenth from any given constellation or the sun's
entrance into it; talc; Brahma, the supreme spirit;
(आ), f. a fountain, a well; [cf. Gr. χάος; Lat.
halo.]
—ख-कामिनी, f. the female of the Falco
Cheela (चिल्ल); an epithet of Durgā (चर्चिका).
—ख-कुन्तल, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—ख-
खोल्क, अस्, m. ‘sky-meteor,’ an epithet of the sun.
—खखोल्कादित्य (˚क-आद्˚), अस्, m. a form of
the sun.
—ख-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, moving in the air;
(अस्), m. a bird; air, wind; the sun; a planet; a
grasshopper; a deity; an arrow.
—ख-गङ्गा, f.
the Gaṅgā (Ganges) of the sky.
—ख-गण, अस्, m.,
N. of a prince, a son of Vajra-nābha.
—ख-गति,
इस्, f. flight in the air; N. of a metre, [cf. अश्व-
गति.]
—खग-पति, इस्, m. the chief of the birds,
an epithet of Garuḍa, the vehicle of Viṣṇu.
—ख-
गम, अस्, आ, अम्, moving in the air, flying, an epi-
thet of the Gandharvas and of missile weapons; (अस्),
m. a bird; N. of a Brāhman.
—ख-गर्भ, अस्,
m., N. of a mythical person with Buddhists.
—खग-
वक्त्र, अस्, m. the tree Artocarpus Lacucha (लकुच).
—खग-वती, f. the earth.
—खग-शत्रु, उस्,
f. a plant, commonly called Chakulīya, Hemionitis
Cordifolia; [cf. पृश्नि-पर्णी.]
—खग-स्थान,
अम्, n. the hollow of a tree; a bird's nest.
—खगा-
धिप (˚ग-अध्˚), अस्, m. the chief of the birds,
an epithet of Garuḍa.
—खगान्तक (˚ग-अन्˚), अस्,
m. a hawk, a falcon (a destroyer of birds).
—ख-
गाभिराम (˚ग-अभ्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—खगासन (˚ग-आस्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of the
mountain Udaya, the eastern mountain, on which the
sun rises; an epithet of Viṣṇu (‘sitting on a bird,’
i. e. on Garuḍa).
—ख-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (in arith-
metic or algebra) having a cypher as multiplier.
—खगेन्द्र (˚ग-इन्˚), अस्, m. the chief of the
birds, an epithet of Garuḍa; N. of a prince.
—ख-
गेन्द्र-ध्वज, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—ख-
गेश्वर (˚ग-ईश्˚), अस्, m. the chief of the birds,
epithet of Garuḍa.
—ख-गोल, अस्, m. the vault or
circle of the heaven, the celestial sphere.
—खगोल-
विद्या, f. knowledge of the celestial sphere, astronomy.
—ख-चमस, अस्, m. the moon (‘the drinking-
vessel in the sky’).
—ख-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, moving
in the air, flying; (अस्), m. a bird; a cloud; the
wind; the sun; a Rakṣas or demon; an aerial
spirit; N. of a people.
—ख-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, moving
in the air, flying, an epithet of Skanda.
—ख-जल,
अम्, n. ‘air-water,’ i. e. dew, rain, frost, hoar-frost.
—ख-जित्, त्, m. a Buddha, one of the seven teachers
or saints of the Buddha sect.
—ख-ज्योतिस्, इस्, m. a
shining flying insect, a fire-fly, &c.
—ख-तमाल,
अस्, m. a cloud; smoke.
—ख-तिलक, अस्, m. the
sun.
—ख-दूर-वासिनी, f., N. of one of the female
deities or Śaktis with Buddhists.
—ख-द्योत, अस्,
m. a shining flying insect, a fire-fly, the sun; (आ), f.,
[]
scil. द्वार्, the door which shines like a shining insect,
an eye.
—ख-द्योतक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
kind of plant with a poisonous fruit.
—ख-द्योतन,
अस्, m. the sun.
—ख-धूप, अस्, m. a rocket, fire-
work.
—ख-पराग, अस्, m. darkness.
—ख-
पुष्प, अम्, n. a flower in the sky, a term for any-
thing impossible.
—ख-भ, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a planet.
—ख-भ्रान्ति, इस्, f. a kind of falcon, a
kite; [cf. चिल्ल.]
—ख-मणि, इस्, m. the jewel of
the sky, the sun.
—ख-मीलन, अम्, n. sleepiness,
lassitude, weariness.
—ख-मूर्ति, इस्, f. a celestial
appearance or person.
—खमूर्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having a divine or celestial person or form.
—ख-
मूलि, इस्, इका or ई, f. an aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes
(कुम्भिका).
—ख-वल्ली, f., N. of a parasitic plant,
= आकाश-वल्ली.
—ख-वारि, इ, n. rain-water, dew,
vapour, &c.
—ख-वाष्प, अस्, m. snow, hoar-frost,
dew.
—ख-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, resting or dwelling in
the air.
—ख-शरीर, अम्, n. a celestial or immortal
body.
—खशरीरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, gifted with an etherial
body, having a heavenly form.
—ख-श्वास, अस्, m.
wind, air.
—ख-सम, अस्, m. a Buddha or deified
Bauddha saint.
—ख-समुत्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, produced
in the sky.
—ख-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced
in the sky, aerial, etherial; (आ), f. spikenard, = आकाश-
मांसी.
—ख-सर्पण, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha or
Bauddha saint; (अम्), n. gliding through the air.
—ख-सिन्धु, उस्, m. the moon.
—ख-स्तनी, f.
the earth.
—ख-स्फटिक, अम्, n. aerial crystal,
a N. for the sun and moon-gem, सूर्य-कान्त
and चन्द्र-कान्त; [cf. आकाश-स्फटिक.]
—ख-
हर, अस्, आ, अम्, (in arithmetic) having a cypher
for its denominator (as a fraction).
—खात्मन् (ख-
आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having the air as one's nature.
—खा-
पगा (ख-आप्˚), f. a stream in the air, an epithet of
the Ganges.
—खे-गमन, अस्, m. a kind of galli-
nule, = काल-कण्ठ.
—खे-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, moving
in the air, flying, aerial; (अस्), m. a bird; a Gan-
dharva; a Rakṣas; a Vidyādhara; an epithet of Śiva;
a planet; quicksilver; (ई), f. a semi-divine female
able to fly; an epithet of Durgā; (अम्), n. green
vitriol.
—खेचर-त्व, अम्, n. capability of flying.
—खे ऽट (खे-अट), अस्, m. a planet; the ascend-
ing node or Rāhu.
—खे-परिभ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्,
flying about in the air.
—खे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्,
lying in the air.
—खोल्क (ख-उल्का), अस्, m. a
meteor; a planet; [cf. ख-खोल्क.]
—खोल्मुक
(ख-उल्˚), अस्, m. the planet Mars; [cf. गगनोल्-
मुक.]

खा खा, (at the end of some compounds)
digging [f. कूप-खा and विस-खा.]
